authority_contract.principle: Phase 7 normalizes bindings and resolution evidence only. Existing authority objects remain the sole business-fact/interpretation authority; no second payload is authored.

verified_behavior: Rich heterogeneous Market Research lineage is normalized to the canonical LINEAGE_FIELDS contract while exact_fact and interpretation remain bound to their original authority paths rather than copied into a second payload.
A shallow row with source_refs cannot fake PASS when exact_fact, interpretation or downstream_use are unbound.
source_type and recency may be derived only from resolvable source authority or embedded source cards; unresolved source references remain explicit issues.
Explicit proof objects and downstream consumers must resolve to final semantic objects; missing proof/downstream targets fail the record instead of being accepted as labels.
Direct canonical_business_object::<key> and production_asset::<id> downstream targets are checked against the final semantic inventory.
Explicit TO_VERIFY/UNKNOWN/MISSING_INPUT boundaries remain explicit deferred lineage rather than being promoted to factual certainty.

Mature information_audit_authority rows remain valid lineage records, while nested evidence/source descriptors are metadata of their parent record and are not double-counted as fake business lineage objects.
The production export wrapper executes REQ-088 lineage materialization before final semantic closure, so the lineage index/audit and Manifest contract are rebuilt into the final ZIP.
The final lineage audit records business_payload_copied=false.
